initial_context: Only config/discovery_initial_packet.json was read. No other study inputs, protocol, or agent outputs were read.
method: Started with outcomes: households safely escaping hazards together, small fleets operating before grid upgrades, and patients obtaining commercially unattractive medicines.
Mapped binding restrictions, stranded resources, counterparties, and each party's outside option.
Used primary prior art to attack novelty; narrowed or rejected familiar coordination and optimization headlines.
Constructed and executed a synthetic participation and financing falsifier for the selected candidate. No field validation, customer contact, paid access, or external write occurred.

sources.title: HUD Climate Resilience Implementation Guide: Community-Driven Relocation
sources.finding: Community relocation, land swaps and land banking already exist. HUD identifies consent, funding alignment, receiving locations, time and remaining households as obstacles.

sources.title: Rancho Palos Verdes Voluntary Property Buyout Program
sources.finding: October 14, 2026 update: reimbursement financing requires small groups of closings; acquisitions and demolitions may take years. Black & Veatch already coordinates escrow and closing logistics.

sources.title: DOE Flexible DER & EV Connections, July 2024
sources.finding: Dynamic operating envelopes, flexible connections, customer and utility control, and curtailment allocation are established approaches.

sources.title: Civica Rx Membership
sources.finding: Long-term supply commitments, reserve inventory, equal prices, and a rural hospital program already address the proposed pooling mechanism.

sources.title: HUD Real Estate Acquisition and Relocation
sources.finding: Federal acquisition and relocation have statutory protections and program-specific requirements; binding instruments require jurisdiction-specific review.

sources.title: FEMA Fact Sheet: Acquisition of Property After a Flood Event
sources.finding: Buyouts are voluntary, involve several governmental parties, and have limited funding.

ranking.name: A jointly contingent right to relocate with replacement housing secured
ranking.status: Provisional recommendation; novelty and enforceability unresolved
ranking.beneficiary_value: Hazard-exposed households can leave together without committing their existing home before a suitable replacement and financing are secured. Municipalities can complete coherent projects rather than leave financing-fragmented cohorts.
ranking.binding_restriction_stranded_resource: A household will not commit without a replacement; sellers will not reserve indefinitely; a municipality may have awarded reimbursement funding but insufficient closing cash. The stranded resource is an approved future payment plus mutually compatible housing transactions.
ranking.specific_prior_art_limitation: S1 already covers collective relocation, land swaps and land banking; S2 already employs professional escrow coordination. The narrower hypothesis is a reusable, independently checkable instrument joining revocable household consent, replacement reservations, grant eligibility, bridge funding and named failure-risk bearers. The inspected sources do not demonstrate that complete instrument; this is not proof it is absent.
ranking.enabling_change: Agents can trace heterogeneous public rules into explicit conditions, construct alternative bundles and adversarially check their cash flows. Actual signatures, valuation, legal authority and underwriting remain human/institutional inputs. Lower assembly cost is a hypothesis, not a measured capability claim.
ranking.connection_discovered: Combine contingent assurance contracts with construction-finance draw conditions and synchronized insured real-estate closing. The valuable output is a new jointly conditional commitment, beyond locating properties or accelerating paperwork.
ranking.construction_falsifier: Construct an eight-household term matrix and escrow state machine: every participant retains withdrawal before closing; replacement and original titles must be jointly ready; approved reimbursement, full bridge and explicit risk coverage must exist; otherwise cancel and charge only the designated sponsor. Local fixture enumerated 24,576 synthetic combinations. Next decisive gate: one public-program dossier must support lawful assignments/guarantees and an affordable complete package. Reject if existing providers already offer the same bundle economically, one required obligation cannot be enforced, households prefer independent moves, or risk-adjusted funding costs exceed avoided delay value.
ranking.commercial_mechanism: A municipality or nonprofit sponsor pays a fixed reviewed-assembly fee and a completion fee; financing is separately priced. Households participate only if their own stated replacement and wealth constraints hold. Sellers receive reservation compensation; lenders receive interest plus explicit loss coverage. The sponsor must prefer these costs to ordinary staggered administration. No subsidy, guarantee, buyer or profit is assumed to exist.
ranking.successor_inheritance: Executable fixture, source-linked condition matrix, typed obligations, outside-option ledger, cancellation counterexamples and rejected novelty claims. Later agents can replace synthetic numbers without inheriting an unsupported claim of viability.

ranking.name: Guaranteed fleet service on a non-firm electricity connection
ranking.beneficiary_value: Small delivery or municipal fleets could begin operation before a firm grid upgrade while buying a specified service commitment.
ranking.binding_restriction_stranded_resource: Available grid capacity is intermittent; the fleet needs reliable departures. Spare charging or vehicle capacity elsewhere cannot support an investment until access is contractually reserved.
ranking.specific_prior_art_limitation: S3 already establishes flexible connections and managed charging; a scheduler is not a discovery. The narrower gap is a jointly purchased fallback charging/vehicle option that backs an enforceable transport-service guarantee. The search did not establish whether charging-as-a-service vendors already supply it.
ranking.enabling_change: Agents could assemble tariff conditions, route constraints, fallback rights and conservative feasibility certificates into an underwritable package; existing engineering control remains necessary.
ranking.connection_discovered: Treat non-firm electricity as an input to a firm transport obligation; reserve substitution rights instead of requiring firm electricity at every depot.
ranking.construction_falsifier: Combine a public connection envelope, disclosed duty cycles and independently confirmed fallback capacities. Test worst-case curtailment and correlated feeder failure, including travel time and simultaneous fallback claims. Reject if the guaranteed routes fail, fallback cannot be exclusively reserved, or premiums exceed waiting/retaining existing vehicles. No such real-data replay was completed here.
ranking.commercial_mechanism: Fleet pays availability premium below its quantified delay cost; fallback operators receive reservation fees above displaced business; guarantor requires premium exceeding correlated tail losses, capital and operations. The grid retains unconditional authority to curtail under its agreement.
ranking.successor_inheritance: Executable service-obligation schemas, capacity reservation graph, adversarial scenarios and explicit correlations; no assumed independence or invented insured capacity.

ranking.name: A pooled option to restart supply of an unattractive generic medicine
ranking.status: Do not advance without a narrower uncovered gap
ranking.beneficiary_value: Patients and small providers need predictable access when ordinary unit sales do not support redundant supply.
ranking.binding_restriction_stranded_resource: Readiness and validation cost money even when demand is uncertain; individually small purchasers cannot cover them. Potentially stranded licensed capacity must be demonstrated, not presumed.
ranking.specific_prior_art_limitation: The initial demand-assurance proposal is substantially anticipated by Civica's long-term commitments and stockpiles (S4), including support for rural hospitals. Only a validated restart option outside existing coverage might remain; no evidence establishes that gap.
ranking.enabling_change: Agents might reduce multi-party specification and commitment-assembly costs, but cannot supply licensed production, validated readiness or regulatory approval.
ranking.connection_discovered: Separate payment for continued production readiness from payment per delivered unit, with allocation rights agreed before a shortage.
ranking.construction_falsifier: Select one publicly documented supply failure, establish an uncovered purchaser group and a legally usable backup producer, then price readiness against inventory and Civica membership. Reject absent available validated capacity or if existing alternatives dominate. This test was not run.
ranking.commercial_mechanism: Purchasers pay a readiness retainer only below expected disruption and inventory costs; producer needs retained fees to cover validation, opportunity cost and availability obligations. Neither willingness to pay nor positive surplus was observed.
ranking.successor_inheritance: A strong negative novelty result, supplier-readiness requirements and a break-even template; avoid repeatedly rediscovering generic procurement pooling.

scoring: 1-5 subjective screening scores, weighted by packet criteria; not probabilities or measured market evidence.

construction_results.illustration: Eight $250,000 buyouts, $265,000 replacements and $5,000 moving costs require $2,000,000 bridge principal. At 8% for 120 days, with $16,000 reservations and $20,000 completion fee, sponsor cash need is $248,602.74, plus explicit full-principal nonreimbursement coverage. These are invented inputs.
construction_results.counterexamples: A $200,000 sponsor cap fails; a 365-day delay raises sponsor need to $356,000 and fails a $250,000 cap; one withdrawal or no loss guarantee cancels. Sponsor loses $16,000 reserved option premiums on cancellation. Household preclosing financial exposure is zero by construction, not verified in real contracts.
construction_results.limitation: Enumerating guards checks internal consistency only. It does not establish enforceability, real valuations, available guarantees, transaction costs, customer demand or superior outcomes. Closing/title readiness is assumed as a gate, not implemented.
construction_results.robustness_finding: The illustrative feasible bundle has only $1,397.26 of sponsor slack and fails beyond 123.1875 reimbursement days. The construction therefore exposes a fragile financing assumption rather than validating a robust opportunity.

rejected_ideas: Generic flexible grid interconnection: mature prior art; not a flagship.
Generic pooled hospital procurement: Civica directly anticipates it.
Generic buyout matching or faster paperwork: existing relocation programs and consultants already do this.
uncertainty: Six queries cannot establish novelty. The flagship's most important unresolved question is whether lawful, affordable loss-bearing and reservation arrangements survive real consent and outside-option constraints. None of the candidates is established as a business or a uniquely frontier-enabled discovery.
